name: gk-portfolio-worker
description: Server-rendered Cloudflare Worker portfolio with D1-backed admin content management.

scripts.check: node --check build.js && node --check worker.js && node --check bundled_worker.js
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.db:migrations:list:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations list gk-portfolio-db-dev --local --env dev
scripts.db:migrations:apply:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply gk-portfolio-db-dev --local --env dev
scripts.db:migrations:apply:staging: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply gk-portfolio-db-staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrations:apply:production: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply gk-portfolio-db-production --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed:local: npx wrangler d1 execute gk-portfolio-db-dev --local --file scripts/seed.sql --env dev
scripts.db:seed:staging: npx wrangler d1 execute gk-portfolio-db-staging --remote --file scripts/seed.sql --env staging
